findings.question: q-earth-science-astronomy-heavenly-bodies-0020
findings.quote: A telescope resolves an object into a vast gravitationally bound system of stars, gas, and dust. Which observation most directly distinguishes it from a single star?
findings.problem: The stem already states that the object is a system of stars. A student can match that wording to “It contains many separate stars.” without knowing how a galaxy differs from a star.
findings.fix: Describe an unresolved fuzzy object, then ask which observation would show that it is a system of stars rather than a single star.
